source_selection_reason: Definitions encountered in consecutive Ptolemy reading and supplied OCR, not participant outcome fitting

ptolemy.position: Reports 2.5-degree places and degree allocations, then rejects/omits these finer schemes.

rhetorius.position: Calls dodecatemories necessary, compares x12 and x13, favors x12/2.5-degree agreement and attributes that rule to Ptolemy.

records.action: Retain Rhetorius technique for its own source profile. Ptolemy's description is not an endorsement. Do not claim two agreeing independent authorities.

ptolemy.position: First three triangles specify day/night principals; fourth has Mars plus Venus(day)/Moon(night).

rhetorius.position: Each triangle has day/night/third-common rulers. Fourth gives Venus/Mars/Moon in those roles.

records.action: Preserve typed roles. A third participating ruler, constant ruler and co-ruler are not silently equivalent.

ptolemy.position: Two or more familiarities with the containing place.

rhetorius.position: Own domicile or exaltation or terms; rejoicing continues under the beams with stated benefic/malefic qualifications.

records.action: Do not merge the OR condition into the Ptolemy two-or-more rule. The under-beams claim is Rhetorius-specific here.

records.topic: Proper face is not a universal synonym for decan

ptolemy.position: Luminary relation and orientation; a note records the stricter scholiast variant.

rhetorius.position: Uses face with decans in chapter10 and proper face with luminary/domicile relations in chapter29.

records.action: Namespace the definitions by chapter/meaning. Do not collapse the two uses into one boolean.
